summary: Map compliance workflows, control evidence and RegTech requirements in five days. Explore the GRC automation course and its practical outputs.
lede: GRC automation turns compliance obligations and control activities into traceable digital workflows. This intermediate training is for compliance professionals who need to plan automation, helping them assess process readiness, map obligations to controls and evidence, and design workflow roles and exception paths. It also covers prioritizing RegTech requirements and defining integration and testing criteria, with practical outputs including process maps, control-evidence matrices, and implementation roadmaps; commercial platform configuration is not included.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who already work with compliance controls, evidence, monitoring or governance processes and need to plan their automation more systematically.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of compliance controls, evidence collection or compliance monitoring is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access; confirm Excel is available before training. Exercises use a blank workbook and learner-selected process examples, with no course dataset or preconfigured platform sandbox.
